canada.title: Sask. musician's terminal brain cancer diagnosis prompts outpouring of support
canada.summary: Julie Atter had a bright and varied career as a musician and as a band instructor. The Regina woman worked tirelessly to promote music and help support kids in their music education. canada.title: How witchcraft lore encouraged kindness among neighbours in Newfoundland and Labrador
